resources.string: Essentia needs \"All files access\" to open games from any folder on your device or SD card. It only reads your games and writes their save files.

No RPG Maker game was found in:
%1$s

Pick the folder that contains Game.exe or Game.ini.
This device has no folder picker. Open Essentia from a frontend instead.
Anything you have not saved in the game will be lost.
Essentia %1$s is ready (you have %2$s). Download and install it now?
The update could not be downloaded. Try again later.
Add a game folder (the one with Game.exe or Game.ini), or a folder with several games: Essentia finds them all.
This game\'s folder was not found. It may have been moved or deleted, or the SD card is not inserted.
Choose a game folder, or a folder with several games
No RPG Maker games were found in:\n%1$s
Touch buttons for phones and tablets.
Automatic (hidden when a controller is connected)
In the library: show the selected game on the second screen
No second screen detected on this device.
Essentia is free software (GNU GPL v2) based on mkxp-z and mkxp-z-android by thehatkid. It does not include any games: you play the ones you have.
You already have the latest version.
Could not check for updates. Check your internet connection.
From the previous Essentia version (%1$d files)
Saves are copied to:\n%1$s\nIf a save with the same name exists, it is kept as a backup.
No save files were found there.
Big games take longer the first time. Your game is loading, not frozen.
Press any button or move a stick
Cancel, open the menu, hold to run
Essentia menu: controls, exit the game
Key settings screen of the game
Each game can change what its keys do; this is how most Pokémon Essentials games work. In Essentials, F1 opens a screen to change the game\'s keys.
Where each game keeps its saves.
In the game\'s folder (same as JoiPlay: saves work in both apps)
In Essentia/Partidas, one folder per game
Open your games from Díptico, ES-DE, Daijishō and other launchers.

Choose a folder in your ROMs (for example ROMs/rpgmaker). Essentia writes a small .essentia file for each game; set up the frontend to open .essentia files with Essentia. New games are added there automatically.
Could not use that folder. Choose one in the internal storage or SD card.
Changes apply the next time you open a game.
Show FPS (frames per second) while playing
Skip frames when the game slows down (smoother speed, less smooth picture)
Vertical sync (avoids tearing; may lower speed)
Exact pixel scaling (sharper, but smaller picture)
High-performance mode (keeps the processor steady while playing)
Run the screen at 60 Hz while playing (even motion on 120 Hz screens)
Diagnostics: show the keys Essentia sends to the game
While playing, the second screen shows:
Live map + game actions (team, bag, save, turbo, cheats)
Ambient borders: the game keeps its 4:3 shape and the sides show a blurred copy of the image.
Original: the game keeps its shape with black bars.
Stretch: fills the whole screen (the image looks wider).
Full widescreen (experimental): menus, battles and title screens also stretch their backgrounds, windows and bars to the edges. Looks great in some games and odd in others.
Each game can have its own format: long-press it in the library → Options → Screen format.
Faster loading (more memory for Ruby at start)
Show loading times when the game starts
This game has no region map to show
That didn\'t work in this game
The game doesn\'t allow saving here
It will open when your character is free (no talking or walking)
This game doesn\'t have that (Pokémon Essentials games only)
You don\'t have the Pokédex yet
Speeds the game up (great for grinding and long dialogs). Turn it on from the second screen or with Select + R1. Select + L1 takes a screenshot.
Some old RPG Maker games need the RTP (standard graphics and sounds). Copy it to: %1$s/XP (RPG Maker XP) %1$s/VX %1$s/VXAce Essentia uses it automatically, without touching the game\'s folder.
Folders created. Copy the RTP\'s Graphics and Audio folders inside.
Classic (Ruby 1.8) — for very old games that show Ruby errors
This version of Essentia doesn\'t include the classic engine yet.
Debug: walk through walls (if the game allows it)
Held buttons are pressed again and again (great for long dialogs)
Opens Android\'s keyboard to type names
Tap a button to change what it does. Select stays as the shortcut button (Select + Start: menu, + R1: turbo, + L1: screenshot).
Vibrate when touching the on-screen controls
Auto Fire on: held buttons repeat
You already have the latest version (%1$s).
The game announces a new version, but its download link isn\'t from MEGA, Dropbox or GitHub.
You have %1$s. Essentia will download %2$s from %3$s, back up your saves and update the game. Your saves are kept.
Couldn\'t check for updates (no internet, or the game\'s link no longer works).
The update comes as %1$s, a format Essentia can\'t open yet (only .zip). Download it on a PC or with a file manager.
Not enough free space: about %1$s are needed.
The update failed. The game was not changed (or only partly: it can be launched again).
This game wants to update itself: close it and open it again, Essentia will offer the new version (or Options → Update the game)
There\'s a new official version of %1$s (you have %2$s, the new one is %3$s). Update before playing? Your saves are kept, and a copy is made first.
For games with an official updater (like Pokémon Añil), Essentia checks for new versions before opening them and offers to update without losing your saves.
Look for new versions before playing
Update cancelled. The game still works; you can try again later.

Version %1$s is downloading in the background. You can keep using the console, play something else or close it: a notification shows the progress and tells you when the game is ready. Your saves are kept.
This game is being updated (%1$s). It will be ready soon: you\'ll get a notification.
Keep updating with the screen off?
So updates keep going when you close the console or turn off the screen, Android needs to let Essentia work in the background. It\'s only used while something is downloading.
Essentia\'s own theme in the library. It stops while you play.
Automatic — recommended: modern, and classic if the game needs it
Confirm in the launcher to add the shortcut
This game\'s scripts file wasn\'t found
Vertical: game on top, controls below
Vertical mode shows the game in its own shape (no widescreen) and leaves the bottom part for the on-screen controls.
Open the last game when Essentia starts
Look for new games in your folders when Essentia starts
Safe widescreen (recommended): the map fills the whole screen; title, menus and battles keep their own shape in the middle, with soft blurred sides. Works well with almost any game.
Fast text (messages appear at once, Pokémon Essentials games)
Skip intro screens before the title
Essentia\'s own database (a Google Drive app): error reports, shared translations and save backups.
Back up my saves after playing
Couldn\'t connect. Check the address and the internet.
The game will be shown in Spanish. Texts are translated as you play (the first time a moment is needed; then they are remembered and shared). Translations are kept in %1$s and can be edited.
Translation is on, but Essentia\'s database isn\'t connected (Settings → Database): only official Pokémon names and descriptions will be translated. Translations are kept in %1$s.
The game will be shown in its own language again. (Translations stay in %1$s.)
Connect Essentia\'s database first (Settings → Database and cloud: address and backup key).
Last backup: %1$s. The last 10 backups of each game are kept.
There are no saves to back up
This game has no backups yet
Bring back the saves from %1$s? Your current saves are kept aside in Essentia/Respaldos first.
Send this report so the problem can be fixed in the next version of Essentia:
Tell what happened (where, what you were doing). The game\'s details go with it.
Include the game\'s scripts (helps a lot)
The report couldn\'t be sent. Check the internet.
Choose Essentia\'s colors. The game panel on the second screen uses them too.
Play RPG Maker XP, VX and VX Ace fan games, like the Pokémon Essentials ones, made for this console.
Press X (or the + button) and choose the folder where your games are. Essentia finds them all and remembers the folder for new ones.
A plays, Y opens each game\'s options (screen, translation, backups, reports). During the game, Select + Start opens the menu.
In Settings (Start) you can change the colors, the screen format, the controls and much more.
A brand new look with categories in Settings, an intro, and everything from the last versions polished.
Settings → Appearance: choose among seven color themes, including one in pure black for OLED screens.
The map fills the screen; title, menus and battles keep their shape with soft sides. Works with almost any game.
In each game\'s options (Y): \"Translate to Spanish\". Official Pokémon names, shared and editable translations.
If a game stops with an error, send the report with one tap. Your saves can be backed up to the cloud after playing.
From the second time on, a game\'s scripts are already prepared, so it opens sooner.
Browse each community in your browser. Essentia runs RPG Maker XP, VX and VX Ace games; ROM hacks need another emulator. Being listed does not mean a game has been tested in Essentia.
Essentia doesn\'t host games: each one is downloaded from its creator\'s official page. The list is updated online, without updating the app.
Download the game from its official page (as .zip) and come back: Essentia finds it in Downloads, installs it and adds it to your library.
Your saves are backed up before every update.
Installing in the background in “%1$s”. It will appear in your library.
%1$s doesn\'t have an RPG Maker game inside (or it\'s .rar/.7z: unzip it and add the folder with +).
Every game in your library, with its version and the latest one.
Your library is empty: add games with + or install one from Explore.
Version %1$s · not in the catalog yet
These are updated from their page
Discover fan games with their language and how well they work in Essentia. Download them from the creator\'s page and Essentia installs the .zip by itself.
Essentia looks for new versions of every game in your library and marks them with “New”. In Store › My games you can update them all at once, keeping your saves.
Controls now work in games made with Essentials 17 and 18 (like Pokémon Cristal and Iberia), which also start with the classic engine directly.
Selected from the first completed games by first-post reaction score on Eevee Expo. Popularity does not confirm Essentia compatibility.
No. %1$d by first-post reaction score on Eevee Expo · checked %2$s

%2$s

Every file and save inside this folder will be permanently deleted. You will confirm once more before anything is deleted.
Also delete the separate saves in:\n%1$s
Separate saves are shared or cannot be safely assigned to this game. They will be kept.

Permanently delete %1$s?

Folders to delete:
%2$s

This cannot be undone. All contents, including saves inside these folders, will be deleted. Cloud backups and files outside these folders are kept.
Close running games and wait for updates or deletion to finish before trying again.
Deleting the selected files… Please wait.

No complete deletion was confirmed. Some files may already have been deleted. The library entry was kept. Check file permissions and make sure this folder is not shared with other games or used as a general storage folder.
Una nueva etapa para teléfono y Thor: guía inicial, herramientas por juego y tienda con páginas y material del creador. La versión de PC queda para más adelante.
Tu equipo, tus notas y tus controles
Controles independientes por juego, carrusel táctil en la pantalla inferior y lectura de equipo, medallas y Pokédex cuando el juego es compatible. Toca las notas del panel para editarlas.

Instalación de ZIP, RAR y 7z con preparación y recuperación; restauración de respaldos locales con doble confirmación. Los avisos diarios y la traducción IA son opcionales y empiezan desactivados. Sigue siendo una beta: reporta errores desde las herramientas de cada juego.
